CARD_AND_ZONE_OPERATIONS.name: Card and Zone Operations
CARD_AND_ZONE_OPERATIONS.description: Movement of cards across physical and logical zones (field, hand, trash, deck, burst, void, remove).

contract.targetingContract: Targeting may be explicit (prior TARGET clause) or inline via selector/filter. Protection from destruction/bounce must be checked via continuous layer.
contract.conditionContract: Pre-flight zone availability and side restrictions enforced via structured conditions.
contract.timingContract: Evaluated at activation timing (WHEN_SUMMONED, FLASH, MAIN, etc.) or triggered on game events.
contract.costContract: Non-cost unless marked isCost: true. Free summons bypass payment plan.
contract.mutationContract: Card instance transferred between state.players[side] arrays; stack representations created/dissolved.
contract.eventContract: Emits SUMMONED, DESTROYED, BOUNCED, or CARD_MOVED events.
contract.failureBehavior: Fail-closed: if destination invalid or target illegal, operation produces NO_OP_BY_RULE without state alteration.
contract.atomicity: Atomic: partial moves fail together or execute up-to specified bounds.

CORE_AND_RESOURCE_OPERATIONS.name: Core and Resource Operations
CORE_AND_RESOURCE_OPERATIONS.description: Conservation and movement of normal cores, Soul Core, Life, and Reserve values.

contract.targetingContract: Source and destination stacks or zones must be legal; Soul Core movement strictly tracked.
contract.conditionContract: Source must possess sufficient cores (normal + soulCore) prior to movement.
contract.timingContract: Instantaneous during clause execution; triggers SBA if stack reduced to 0 cores.
contract.costContract: When clause isCost === true, exact required core count must be moved or whole ability aborts.
contract.mutationContract: Direct mutation of core numbers in reserve, field stacks, trash, void, or life.
contract.eventContract: Emits CORE_MOVED, LIFE_REDUCED, or SOUL_CORE_MOVED events.
contract.failureBehavior: Aborts ability activation if cost payment; produces no-op if optional or unfulfillable.
contract.atomicity: Strictly conserved: sum of reserve + field + trash + life + void cores remains invariant.

DECK_AND_HAND_OPERATIONS.name: Deck and Hand Operations
DECK_AND_HAND_OPERATIONS.description: Drawing, milling, revealing, searching, and manipulating card orders.

contract.targetingContract: Selection from deck or hand via InteractionController prompt.
contract.conditionContract: Subject to CANNOT_DRAW, CANNOT_MILL, or HAND_SIZE restrictions.
contract.costContract: Discarding from hand can serve as activation cost.
contract.mutationContract: Card references moved between deck/hand/trash arrays.
contract.eventContract: Emits DRAWN, MILLED, CARDS_REVEALED, or DISCARDED events.
contract.failureBehavior: Deck out during mandatory draw triggers game loss in SBA; empty searches cleanly return empty sets.
contract.atomicity: Revealed cards not added to hand return to deck bottom or trash deterministically.

BP_AND_COMBAT_OPERATIONS.name: BP and Combat Operations
BP_AND_COMBAT_OPERATIONS.description: BP modifications, battle state alterations, exhaustion, refresh, and combat constraints.

contract.targetingContract: Targets active spirit stacks or allied/opposing field cards.
contract.conditionContract: Target must be on field and match filter criteria.
contract.timingContract: Applies as continuous modifier or immediate state toggle (EXHAUST/REFRESH).
contract.costContract: Exhausting self can serve as activation cost.
contract.mutationContract: State modifier registered in state.modifiers with duration and timestamp.
contract.eventContract: Emits BP_CHANGED, SPIRIT_EXHAUSTED, SPIRIT_REFRESHED, or COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED.
contract.failureBehavior: If target left field, modifier applies to null stack and is pruned on next recalculation.
contract.atomicity: BP debuff reaching <= 0 triggers destruction in subsequent SBA pass.

TARGETING_AND_DECISION_OPERATIONS.name: Targeting and Decision Operations
TARGETING_AND_DECISION_OPERATIONS.description: Explicit selection of cards, colors, levels, families, and branches via InteractionController.

contract.targetingContract: Filters legal candidates from state zones honoring Armor and immunity.
contract.conditionContract: Mandatory choices must have >= 1 legal candidate or clause fails; optional can decline.
contract.timingContract: Dispatches asynchronous interactive prompt; pauses execution until Promise resolves.
contract.costContract: Targeting itself is non-cost; chosen target can be consumed by downstream cost.
contract.failureBehavior: Optional decline sets declined: true and clears targeting context.
contract.atomicity: Selection bounds strictly validated against candidate count.

CONDITIONS_AND_RESTRICTIONS.name: Conditions and Restrictions
CONDITIONS_AND_RESTRICTIONS.description: Action limitations, immunities, protections, and once-per-turn budget enforcement.

contract.targetingContract: Applies globally or targets specific card instances/types.
contract.conditionContract: Evaluates state predicates (colors, levels, core counts, turn history).
contract.timingContract: Checked before activation and dynamically checked at resolution time.
contract.costContract: Budget restrictions (Once per turn) consumed at Stage 4 Atomic Commit.
contract.mutationContract: Registers active restrictions in state.restrictions and modifiers in state.modifiers.
contract.failureBehavior: Violated restrictions fail-fast and reject activation or operation execution.
contract.atomicity: Two-phase reservation guarantees atomic rollback if execution aborts before commitment.

CONTINUOUS_TIMING_AND_TRIGGER_OPERATIONS.name: Continuous, Timing, and Trigger Operations
CONTINUOUS_TIMING_AND_TRIGGER_OPERATIONS.description: Persistent rules, trigger listeners, step/turn enders, and continuous modifier layers.

contract.targetingContract: Listens for game events and queries matching card instances.
contract.conditionContract: Evaluates trigger conditions when relevant event is dispatched.
contract.timingContract: Continuous modifiers active while card remains on field; triggers enqueue on event bus.
contract.costContract: Continuous effects have no cost; triggered abilities may require costs.
contract.mutationContract: Registers watchers in event bus or continuous modifier pipeline.
contract.failureBehavior: Unsupported continuous rules log diagnostics without corrupting state.
contract.atomicity: Pruned deterministically at scope boundaries (STEP, BATTLE, TURN).

SPECIALIZED_MECHANICS.name: Specialized Mechanics
SPECIALIZED_MECHANICS.description: Complex signature mechanics: Advent, Burst, Mirage, Rebirth, Grandwalker, Bunshin, and Contract.

contract.targetingContract: Advent targets compatible base spirit; Mirage sets into designated mirage slot.
contract.conditionContract: Prerequisites (card level, color, family, Soul Core) evaluated via parseAdventDeclaration.
contract.timingContract: Advent in Main/Attack Flash; Burst in Burst Window; Mirage in Main Step.
contract.costContract: Soul Core movement to trash/field required for Advent; Mirage cost paid as magic/nexus.
contract.mutationContract: Constructs multi-card stack with pre-advent cards; flips dual-sided cards for Rebirth.
contract.eventContract: Emits ADVENTS, BURST_ACTIVATED, REBIRTH_PERFORMED, or MIRAGE_SET.
contract.failureBehavior: Invalid base spirit or unmet prerequisite prevents advent/mirage action.
contract.atomicity: Card stack and core movement committed as a single atomic unit.

KEYWORD_ABILITIES.name: Keyword Abilities
KEYWORD_ABILITIES.description: Named game keywords and ability triggers (Clash, Armor, Heavy Armor, Rush, Confront, Tribute, etc.).

contract.targetingContract: Applies to card stack or grants keyword to specified targets.
contract.conditionContract: Subject to level requirements and color prerequisites (e.g. Rush).
contract.timingContract: Hooks into combat flow, attack declaration, blocking, or damage step.
contract.costContract: Cost determined by specific keyword definition.
contract.mutationContract: Registers keyword in active keyword registry or stack continuous cache.
contract.failureBehavior: Unknown keywords produce UNHANDLED_KEYWORD diagnostic without crash.
contract.atomicity: Synchronous keyword hooks resolve immediately during combat step.

SYSTEM_AND_ATTRIBUTE_OPERATIONS.name: System and Attribute Operations
SYSTEM_AND_ATTRIBUTE_OPERATIONS.description: Card attributes, colors, symbols, families, copy effects, and engine administration.

contract.targetingContract: Modifies attributes of self or target field stacks.
contract.conditionContract: Evaluates whether target matches recipient requirements.
contract.timingContract: Applies as continuous modifier or immediate attribute rewrite.
contract.mutationContract: Modifies symbol/color/family arrays or continuous modifier registry.
